title: Spend-Controlled Agent Workflow Checklist
who_it_is_for: Commerce agents, procurement agents, and builders designing delegated spend interfaces.
when_to_use: Use when an agent recommends, compares, or requests approval for purchases or subscriptions.
checklist: Confirm spend authority, budget, recurrence, refund terms, and approval threshold.
Compare total cost, not just sticker price: shipping, tax, fees, renewal, switching, and return friction.
Evaluate merchant trust: identity, policy clarity, delivery reliability, warranty, and support burden.
Prepare a human-readable approval request with alternatives and the specific commitment being made.
escalation_criteria: The spend is outside the explicit budget or authority.
The purchase creates a subscription, contract, public commitment, or sensitive-data exposure.
The merchant terms are unclear or materially worse than alternatives.
